items.title: Finland's white-tailed eagle success story: What long-term data reveal about recovery
items.summary: The white-tailed eagle (Haliaeetus albicilla) was once a rare species in Europe due to persecution and pollution. Thanks to legal protection and cleaner environments, many populations have been increasing.
